integrity_notes: Complete analytic proof, physical normalization, and reproducible finite numerical checks are supplied; finite diagnostics do not certify all-parameter statements.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional Brownian motion with deterministic negative proportional jumps, Poisson event times and an absorbing half-line; exact point occupation is not counted in the same way as jump-crossing capture.
No optimization of resetting rates, random multipliers, or joint q-to-one/high-rate crossover.
Novelty and proof have received no independent external validation.
title: Threshold capture under sign-reversing proportional resets: exact mean, jump-channel law, and a singular reflection endpoint
